verdict_reason: The tab tests prove the three tabs, the default and unknown-tab fallback, each panel's heading, columns, rows and Type labels, and the API role listing, but a test of the global-setup fixture helper is filed in the tabs spec.

todos.issue: The 'Address book fixture reconcile' describe (lines 129-158) tests ensureE2eAddressBook, the global-setup seeding helper in flows/shared/address-book-seed.ts. It says nothing about the address book's tabs, yet it sits in the tabs spec, so a reader looking for what keeps the shared fixtures correct will not find it, and a reader of the tabs spec meets a test of test support. It also rebuilds placeOfOriginFixture field by field (lines 132-141) only to swap its roles, where { ...placeOfOriginFixture, ...heldAsConsignor } says the same thing.
todos.fix: Must: the test of ensureE2eAddressBook lives in a spec named for the shared address-book fixtures, not in the tabs spec, and builds its stale record as the fixture with only its roles changed. One way: move the describe into tests/ins/e2e/features/address-book/address-book-fixtures.spec.ts and create the record with { ...placeOfOriginFixture, ...heldAsConsignor }.
